construct: Best Case/Worst Case is a scenario-planning communication tool that compares treatment options by describing a range of plausible trajectories for each option, including the best case, worst case, and most likely outcome, to support preference-sensitive shared decision making.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: The surgeon compares treatment options by narrating the best plausible, worst plausible, and most likely future trajectories and then connects those scenarios to patient goals. This is Best Case/Worst Case scenario planning.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: SPIKES is a bad-news delivery protocol, NURSE responds to emotion, Ask-Tell-Ask structures information exchange, and teach-back verifies comprehension; none is defined by scenario-based best/worst/most-likely treatment trajectories.
adversarial_second_pass.expert_reviewer_reversal: The explicit three-trajectory scenario structure uniquely identifies Best Case/Worst Case and avoids overlap with previously finalized communication frameworks.
